Workflows.//: Dev/E2E only. The E2E suite publishes into one shared admin workspace and never cleans up, so the production default (100) is reached after a few local runs. Production leaves this unset and gets the default.

Clients.//: Dev/E2E only, for the same reason as Workflows. Production leaves this unset and gets the default (1000).

DeviceRegistration.//: Dev/E2E only. The limiter partitions on the caller's IP and every E2E scenario registers devices from the same one, so the production default trips within a few scenarios. Production leaves this unset and gets the default.

DeviceLogin.//: Dev/E2E only, for the same reason as DeviceRegistration.

Api.//: Dev/E2E only. Many scenarios share the seeded admin, and the suite runs faster than a person clicks. Production leaves this unset and gets the default (600 a minute, bursts of 120).
